title.zh: 巴科奥尔—达斯马里尼亚斯国道
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Molino-Salawag-Paliparan Road, Traversing Barangay Talaba 4 in the City of Bacoor, and Barangay Paliparan I in the City of Dasmarinas, All in the Province of Cavite, as "Bacoor-Dasmariñas National Road"
title.th: ทางหลวงแห่งชาติ Bacoor-Dasmariñas

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2018/ra_11048_2018.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Molino-Salawag-Paliparan Road, traversing barangay Talaba 4, Niog 3, Ligas 2, Ligas 3, Bayanan, Mambog 4, Molino 2, Molino 3 and Molino 4 in the City of Bacoor, Cavite to barangays Salawag, Palipara 3, Paliparan 2 and Paliparan 1 in the City of Dasmariñas National Road.
The Department of Public Works and Highways shall place appropriate markers along the aforementioned national road and issue the necessary orders and circulars to implement the provision of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation.

titleTranslation.note: 由翻译 agent 按《法规标题中译规范》产出，经 tools/verify-title-return.js 机器校验后入库；尚未人工复核。
